# A Day in the Life at North Bend


Your first look at Charlotte's newest townhome community — the neighborhood, the hot spots, and everything in between


Tri Pointe Homes


•


September 12, 2026


Share this article


****[North Bend](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/charlotte/north-bend) is Tri Pointe Homes' newest collection of townhomes — 176 homes in total, with three floor plans ranging from 1,487 to 1,814 square feet. What sets North Bend apart from the start: every single home here is an end unit. That means no shared walls on both sides, extra windows that let natural light pour in, and a fenced front yard that's entirely your own.


But a home is only half the story. The other half is everything around it — and North Bend's location might be the best part.


---


## The Everyday: Coffee, Groceries, and the Little Stuff


North Bend · Ballantyne, NC


> *Good everyday living starts close to home, and North Bend delivers.*


-


**Archive CLT (coffee) — about 1 mile away.** A local coffee shop known for its warm, character-filled atmosphere and standout lattes. The kind of place that makes your morning routine feel a little more special.


-


**Food Lion (grocery) — about 1 mile away.** Your go-to for the everyday run: dinner ingredients, the thing you forgot last time, all without eating into your evening.


-


**Kennedy Branch Greenway (recreation) — less than a mile away.** A quiet, tree-lined trail perfect for a morning walk, an evening run, or getting the dog some exercise without ever getting in the car.


These are the small, daily conveniences that make a neighborhood actually livable — and at North Bend, they're all just minutes from your front door.


---


## Charlotte's Hot Spots, Minutes Away


> *North Bend's real draw is how close it sits to some of Charlotte's most talked-about destinations:*


-


**Camp North End — about 3 miles away.** A 76-acre creative hub built inside a former Ford factory, now packed with restaurants, breweries, shops, art installations, and even pickleball courts. Easily a half-day (or full-day) destination on its own.


-


**Optimist Hall — about 4 miles away.** A beautifully restored historic mill turned food hall, with dozens of vendors under one roof — everything from empanadas to dumplings to wood-fired pizza.


-


**NoDa Arts District — about 4 miles away.** Charlotte's eclectic arts neighborhood, known for colorful murals, independent galleries, live music venues, and a genuinely walkable strip of restaurants and bars.


-


**Uptown Charlotte — about 4 miles away.** The city's skyline core, with rooftop bars, sports venues, theaters, and the kind of restaurant scene worth dressing up for.


-


**South End — about 6 miles away.** Charlotte's trendiest live-work-play district, connected by the light rail, with breweries, boutique fitness studios, and a dense cluster of bars and restaurants.


-


**Charlotte Douglas International Airport — about 9 miles away.** Easy in, easy out, whether it's a work trip or a weekend away.


Every one of these is reachable in well under 20 minutes — meaning North Bend puts an entire city's worth of options within easy reach, without asking you to actually live in the middle of it.


---


## Local Recreation, Right Outside Your Door


Beyond the greenway just up the road, North Bend's location connects easily to Charlotte's broader network of parks and trails, including the Little Sugar Creek Greenway system that winds through Uptown and beyond — ideal for anyone who wants an active, outdoor-oriented lifestyle without a long drive to find it. Add in nearby pickleball courts at Camp North End, and staying active here rarely requires leaving the neighborhood.


---


## A Home Base for Your Next Chapter


Whether it's a quiet weekday morning with coffee in hand or a Saturday spent bouncing between Camp North End and a NoDa gallery crawl, North Bend is built to put real Charlotte living within reach — all while giving you a private, low-maintenance home to come back to at the end of it. No shared walls, no compromises, just a place that's entirely your own.


---
